Finding: No global security block - new endpoints will be unprotected by default
Any member can accept or decline requests on a book they do not own
Any member can view borrow requests for a book they do not own
Any member can upload a photo to a book they do not own
Any member can mark a loan as returned on a book they did not borrow
Free-text search parameter vulnerable to SQL injection if concatenated
Connection strings risk being stored in .env committed to Git
Plain HTTP requests can bypass Front Door WAF and rate limiting

No rate limit owners can be spammed with borrow requests
